numeric_controls.limits: Selected arithmetic controls contain related pairs/operators.17 mismatches are comparison observations, not17 distinct policy/model bugs, a model accuracy score, a complete runtime conformance suite, or proof all26 candidate policies are affected. binding_and_execution_review: make_binding independently checks frozen manifest hash/selection, exact candidate HEAD, every published run artifact and original source, canonical profile, repository runtime pins, source-set agreement and original executable load paths. A binding is identity evidence, not source-reading evidence.

Runtime copies contain only original manifest-listed policy/data, not selftests. JSON directories are loaded at their original roots to preserve data.o6_1b. Each copy is hashed again; exact executable SHA is checked. Capabilities remove HTTP/DNS/current-time/random/runtime-metadata builtins and deny network; strict compilation, strict builtin errors and10s evaluation/20s process limits are retained.

allowed_query accepts exact measure namespaces, the exact historical query or a literal explicit whitelist entry. The fixture is trusted repository review code, not an external query endpoint; its bytes, inputs and expectations are hashed.
Typed recursive comparisons distinguish boolean/number/null. Absent fields are recorded with actual_absent, defined null keeps output:null, undefined/error/timeout do not acquire an invented output.

Validator checks modern fixture/observation identities, effective queries, runtime metadata, unique nonempty case IDs, nonempty expectations, native input objects, input/binding/fixture hashes, typed checks and typed summaries. Semantic source review remains a human/agent task.

Queue completion is a consecutive prefix and only its first unfinished measure may be in progress. Coverage preserves duplicate proposals as a multiset and uses historical table pointers; listing coverage does not establish correctness.
